First, we pull out the factor of $2$ from the denominator:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{3x-4}{2x+3}\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{3x-4}{2(x+\frac{3}{2})}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{3x-4}{(x+\frac{3}{2})}\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we draw up our synthetic division table to decompose the integrand into its quotient and remainder.

$$
\begin{aligned} & x & {x}^{0} \\ -\frac{3}{2} & 3 & -4 \\  & ↓ & -\frac{9}{2} \\  & 3 & -\frac{17}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

So from the synthetic division, we get that

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3x-4}{(x+\frac{3}{2})} & =3-\frac{(\frac{17}{2})}{(x+\frac{3}{2})} \\  & =3-\frac{17}{2(x+\frac{3}{2})} \\  & =3-\frac{17}{2x+3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{3x-4}{2x+3}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{2}{\int }_{0}^{2}(3-\frac{17}{2x+3})\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[3{\int }_{0}^{2}\text{d}x-17{\int }_{0}^{2}\frac{1}{2x+3}\,\text{d}x] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}{[3x-\frac{17}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡|2x+3|]}_{0}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[3(2-0)-\frac{17}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡|2(2)+3|-\operatorname{ln}⁡|2(0)+3|)] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[6-\frac{17}{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡7-\operatorname{ln}⁡3)] \\  & =\frac{1}{2}[6-\frac{17}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{7}{3})] \\  & =3-\frac{17}{4}\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{7}{3}).\end{aligned}
$$
